title: Danmaku Shrine 弹幕魔境
description: A vertical bullet-hell boss rush through a haunted shrine! Four yokai bosses each guard two phases of dense rotating spell cards. Your hitbox is a tiny 2.5px dot — hold Shift for precision focus mode and weave through curtains of glowing danmaku. Graze bullets for bonus points and fill the extend meter for extra bombs, bomb-clear overwhelming patterns, and either outlast the spell timer to capture it or blast the boss down for kill bonuses. Survive all four bosses to suppress the realm!
controls: Arrow keys / WASD to move, hold Shift for slow focus mode (shows your hitbox), X to bomb (clears all bullets, 3 charges + extends from graze meter). Player shots are automatic. P pauses, M mutes. Touch: drag pad to move, focus and bomb buttons on the right.
author: LightGame
